Forensic Science Meets Law — Where Science Strengthens Justice. ⚖️🔬
Forensic science is no longer confined to laboratories—it has become an essential part of legal investigation, public policy, governance, and scientific decision-making.
I’m pleased to be part of the 2nd Edition of the Capacity Building Programme/FDP on “Forensic Sciences: An Interdisciplinary Interface with Law, Social Sciences and Allied Disciplines”, organized by Integral University, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh in association with Law Teachers India.
The session featured Shivani Gupta, Question Document Expert, Anil Gupta Forensic Services, on the insightful topic:📌 “Public Policy, Governance and Scientific Investigation”
The session offered valuable insights into how forensic expertise can contribute to evidence-based investigation, effective governance, public policy, and the administration of justice.
As a law student, exposure to interdisciplinary fields like forensic science helps bridge the gap between legal theory and real-world investigation—an increasingly important skill for the modern legal professional.
Grateful for the opportunity to learn, explore, and understand how law + science + technology can work together to strengthen the justice system.
⚖️ Learn beyond the classroom. Think beyond the statute. Investigate beyond assumptions.
